filing_office: New Hampshire Secretary of State, Corporation Division
filing_fee_notes: Base filing fee; additional online processing charges were not confirmed.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain an individual or eligible business entity at a physical New Hampshire registered office, not a P.O. box. The agent should be available during regular business hours.
annual_report_due: April 1 each year following the year of registration.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: Business Profits Tax and Business Enterprise Tax may apply. For tax periods beginning on or after January 1, 2025, the published filing thresholds are gross business income over 109000 for BPT, and gross receipts or enterprise value tax base over 298000 for BET.
state_tax_registration_agency: New Hampshire Department of Revenue Administration
plain_english_summary: File a Certificate of Formation and maintain a registered agent. File an annual report after the registration year.
common_mistake: Do not assume forming the LLC settles your business tax obligations.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic LLC. Official indexed SOS material was used where direct access returned 403. Annual reports received after April 1 incur a 50 late fee. The UI URL is the Revenue Department's official referral page to Employment Security. Name reservation fee, fixed standard processing time, expedite options, publication requirements and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed. Business-tax thresholds are period-specific, not a universal LLC charge.
